pillars.title: Four Ways I Can Help
pillars.subheadline: Define the product, build the software, and make informed technical decisions.

problems.title: Problems I Solve
items: You have a product idea but need clear requirements and an MVP scope.
Manual workflows and disconnected tools are slowing your business down.

You need product leadership or an architecture review before your next investment.

process.title: How I Work
process.subheadline: Discover → Design → Build → Launch → Improve. Each engagement has an agreed scope, review points, and clear responsibilities.

featured.title: ClinchDesk
featured.description: A multi-tenant customer support SaaS platform with ticket management, role-based access control, customer portals, SLA workflows, knowledge management, and AI-assisted support.

engagements.title: How You Can Hire Me
engagements.subheadline: Start with discovery, scope a build, or bring in ongoing technical product leadership.

differentiator.title: Why Work With Me
differentiator.text: Product decisions and engineering decisions belong in the same conversation. My work connects requirements, architecture, and implementation. Explore ClinchDesk for an example of the product scope, and use a discovery call to assess the fit for your project.

items.q: Can you help define an MVP?
items.a: Yes. Discovery engagements clarify requirements, priorities, feasibility, and a delivery roadmap before a build is scoped.

items.q: Do you build software as well as advise?
items.a: Yes. Custom engineering includes hands-on implementation. Advisory provides recommendations and designs; the proposal makes the distinction explicit.

items.q: Is AI required for every project?
items.a: No. AI is one capability. The solution should fit the business problem, whether that needs custom software, integrations, automation, or product leadership.
Support, maintenance, and operational responsibilities are agreed separately or explicitly included in the proposal. A product advisory retainer does not imply on-call engineering support.

finalCta.title: Let’s discuss what your business needs next.
finalCta.text: Bring your product idea, delivery challenge, or technology question. We will explore the scope and practical next steps.
